preconditions.expression: isinstance(t, str) and all(c.islower() for c in t) and 1 <= len(t) <= 10**4
preconditions.description: Input string t consists of lowercase Latin letters with length n between 1 and 10^4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '! ' + s and len(s) == len(t) and all(c.islower() for c in s)
postconditions.description: Outputs the original string s (of same length as t) prefixed with '! ' exactly once, with no additional queries after the answer.

postconditions.expression: all(len(query) == len(t) and all(c.islower() for c in query) for query in queries) and len(queries) <= 3
postconditions.description: Each query string has length n and consists of lowercase Latin letters; no more than 3 queries are made.

postconditions.expression:
all('? ' + query + '
' in stdout_history for query in queries) and all('
' + response + '
' in stdin_history for response in responses)
postconditions.description: Queries are sent in the format '? s' followed by newline, and responses are read as full lines after each query.

postconditions.expression: s == t if len(queries) == 0 else (all(t[i] == s[perm[i]] for i in range(len(t))) for perm in permutations if perm == deduce_permutation(queries, responses))
postconditions.description: The deduced string s is consistent with the observed swaps: if queries are made, s is a permutation of t that matches the observed transformations.
